name: Pinecone Ridge Demo Squadron study deck

cards.q: What time is Monday morning formation at the demo squadron?
cards.a: Formation is at 0630. Be in place by 0620.
keyPoints: Uniform is the unit's published uniform of the day
cards.source: Pinecone Ridge Demo Squadron SOP 2026, para 2-1

cards.q: Where do Soldiers turn in a lost-item report?
cards.a: At the squadron supply window, using the demo squadron's lost-item form.
cards.source: Pinecone Ridge Demo Squadron SOP 2026, para 5-3

cards.q: Who approves a weekend pass request in the demo squadron?
cards.a: The troop commander approves it, after the request goes through the platoon sergeant.
keyPoints: Request goes to the platoon sergeant first
cards.source: Pinecone Ridge Demo Squadron SOP 2026, para 3-4

cards.q: What year was the demo squadron activated?
cards.a: 2026, as an example unit made up for GUIDON's tests.
cards.source: Pinecone Ridge Demo Squadron history handout (fictional)

cards.q: What is on the demo squadron's guidon?
cards.a: A white pine cone on a teal field.
cards.source: Pinecone Ridge Demo Squadron history handout (fictional)

cards.q: What is the demo squadron's nickname?
Name the demo squadron's three local board study topics.
cards.a: Local SOP, unit history, and the squadron training calendar.
cards.source: Pinecone Ridge Demo Squadron board SOP (fictional)
